evals.name: all-roles-for-workflow-args
evals.prompt: Give me the role map to pass as args.roles to a workflow. This session runs on Fable.
evals.expected_output: Runs scripts/route.sh all session=fable and prints the JSON in one fenced json block, then one line per role. Every fan-out variant except retrieval names opus; the single variants of orchestrator, worker and verifier read `inherit: omit the model option`.
expectations: The bundled route.sh is run with all and session=fable
The JSON is printed unchanged in a fenced json block
The fan-out lines for worker and verifier name opus, not fable and not inherit
Each inherit variant is written as `inherit: omit the model option`

evals.name: unknown-role
evals.expected_output: The script exits 2 naming the valid roles (orchestrator, worker, verifier, retrieval, or all). The answer relays that list and stops without guessing a role.
expectations: The valid roles from the error are relayed
No role is substituted for judge

evals.name: rejected-layer-value-is-reported
evals.prompt: What effort does the worker role resolve to for research work? My .claude/multi-agent.local.yaml sets roles.worker.model to claude-opus-5-5.
evals.expected_output: Runs route.sh worker research with the session alias. The worker resolves to effort low; the notes say roles.worker.model was rejected because a full model id is not an alias, and the model comes from the layer below.
expectations: The research workload is passed so effort resolves to low
The rejected key is reported from notes, with the reason that only aliases are accepted
The skill does not edit the overlay file

evals.name: route-mechanical-sonnet
evals.prompt: Which model should the workers use for a pass that reformats 80 markdown tables? This session runs on Opus.
evals.expected_output: Runs route.sh worker mechanical session=opus. With no layer overriding it, both the single and the fan-out variant of the worker name sonnet at effort medium, and the answer says the mechanical workload supplies sonnet by default, with roles.worker.workloads.mechanical.model: inherit as the opt-out.
expectations: The mechanical workload is passed to route.sh, not code
The worker line names sonnet for both the single and the fan-out variant, not inherit
The opt-out key roles.worker.workloads.mechanical.model: inherit is named

evals.name: route-effort-cap-note
evals.prompt: Route all roles for a workflow; my managed settings set maxEffortLevel to medium. This session is Sonnet.
evals.expected_output: Runs route.sh all session=sonnet and prints the JSON unchanged: the verifier still reads effort high, because route reads no settings file. After the per-role lines it writes `Effort above maxEffortLevel runs at the cap; see reference/config.md "Hard cap".` and says the verifier will run at medium under that cap.
expectations: The printed JSON is not edited to lower any effort to medium
The cap note line appears after the per-role lines
The answer says effort above medium runs at medium at run time
No settings file is read or written
